module: Node "Race CP Reached" (repeat_instant). Lets an impulse through when the player crosses a race checkpoint. Outputs: checked (impulse), vehId (hidden), index (checkpoint), lap (current lap, counted with data.lapDiff). Receives the hook onRaceWaypointReached.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes enterFlag, lap = 1 and clearOutPinsOnStart = false.

onRaceWaypointReached.desc: Hook: stores vehId, index (data.cur) and updates the lap (data.lapDiff).

work.desc: Writes checked = enterFlag then resets it to false.

onScenarioRestarted.desc: Scenario restart hook: resets the node.
